review.confirmBody: You won't be able to change it after this. Check the transcript and pills once more.

sheds.title: Sheds
sheds.hint: Turning a shed off also turns off every machine in it.
sheds.readOnlyHint: Machines inside these sheds are yours to manage. Only the owner account can add, switch off, or remove a shed itself.
sheds.empty: No sheds yet. Add the first one above.
sheds.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete "{{name}}" and every machine and log under it? This cannot be undone.

machines.title: Machines
machines.bulkHint: Enter a range like 1-56 to create many machines at once
machines.hint: Rename or move a machine to fix a bad batch add. Deleting one removes every log under it, for good.
machines.readOnlyHint: Tap a number to switch it on or off. Only the owner account can add, rename, move, or delete a machine.
machines.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete machine "{{machineNo}}" and every log under it? This cannot be undone.

users.title: Users
users.hintOwner: Create any account. Admins and operators are shed-scoped once you pick which sheds they can see.
users.hintAdmin: Add operators and share access to your own sheds with them. You can only manage operators you added yourself.
users.empty: No operators added yet. Add the first one above.

taxonomy.title: Taxonomy
taxonomy.synonymsHint: Comma separated. Include how operators actually say it, in Devanagari and Latin.

history.title: History
history.editReasonRequired: A reason is required to save this edit.
history.deleteConfirm: Delete this log? It stops appearing in history and exports.
history.purgeConfirm: Permanently delete this log? This cannot be undone, not even by you.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.machineHistoryTitle: Actions and parts logged on this machine

meters.title: Meters
meters.hint: Add a meter for each shed and assign machines to it. A meter can be shared by several machines.
meters.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete meter "{{code}}" and every reading recorded on it? This cannot be undone.

webhooks.title: Integrations
webhooks.hint: Push every approved maintenance log and every meter reading to a URL you supply — a Google Apps Script Web App is the usual fit for landing data in a Google Sheet. Owner tier only, since a webhook URL can send shed data anywhere.
webhooks.secretHint: Copy this now — it will not be shown again. Every delivery is signed with it (HMAC-SHA256, header X-Webhook-Signature) so your script can verify it really came from here.
webhooks.deleteConfirm: Remove the webhook to "{{url}}"? It will stop receiving data immediately.
